# NewPath Online

> > NewPath Online provides standards-aligned K-12 digital curriculum resources with interactive multimedia lessons and activities for teachers and students.

NewPath Learning's digital platform offers comprehensive educational materials spanning K-8 grade levels across core subject areas. The platform emphasizes interactive learning tools and multimedia content designed to support both classroom instruction and remote teaching.
